sourceInventory: Current Git index; existing regular files only

content.note: Source-only export replaces the original catalog and excludes its content collections; no external content paths are followed.

reviewRequired: Allowlist and path checks are not a secrets, privacy or license certification; review the manifest and selected files before publication.

lineEndingNormalization.scope: Published Git blobs and GitHub source archive
lineEndingNormalization.rule: Git text attributes normalize these files to LF. Original working-tree hashes are retained as sourceSha256/sourceSize; clone line endings can depend on Git configuration.

publicationReview.scope: Development source and reviewed architecture fixtures only
